A gem in Hue
Aug 2026 • Family
Maison Trang, a gem in Hue
For me, the best restaurant in Hue! 
You have to go through a small alley to discover Maison Trang: a simple, family-run restaurant without any fuss, where you come mainly for the essentials: delicious dishes, a warm welcome, and an adorable staff, always smiling and attentive.
And to finish the meal, a very appreciated little gesture: a complimentary plate of fruit. 🍉🍍
A place to discover without hesitation. If I lived here, I would come back again and again!
Bravo to the whole team and thank you for this superb moment!

A Hidden Gem Down the Alleyway
Jun 2026 • Couples
We visited Maison Trang after receiving a recommendation that it offered excellent food at a great price. Following a walk down a small alleyway lined with hostels, we arrived at this charming little restaurant, its tiled exterior standing out amongst the surrounding buildings.

Once inside, we were quickly shown to a table and presented with the menus.

We ordered:

* 3 Cokes
* Large set menu (8 dishes)

The food arrived gradually rather than all at once, which actually worked well as it allowed us to enjoy each dish individually without feeling rushed. As each plate arrived, we were treated to fresh aromas and plenty of flavour. The variety offered by the set menu was particularly enjoyable, giving us the opportunity to try several different dishes in one meal.

Everything tasted fresh and well prepared, with each dish bringing something slightly different to the table. The portions were generous and left us feeling more than satisfied by the end of the meal.

The atmosphere was relaxed and the service efficient throughout our visit, making for a very pleasant dining experience.

The final bill came to just 255,000 VND (£7.14), which we felt was exceptional value considering the quantity and quality of the food we received. Once again, Vietnam demonstrated just how far your money can go when dining out.

A great recommendation and somewhere we would happily visit again
